items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: Lyman wired me in New York to come and put the band in there.

ctx.x: Yeah. And when I was...went to New York with that picture you saw me up on the bootblack stand, they opened the Plantation in Culver City--the Plantation night club--and Lyman wired me in New York to come and put the band in there. So when I came back to put the band in there, we put Mutt and them in there--Kid Ory and them in there. I didn't have no band. In the music store, every time I got a job, I'd get three or
